summary: A toolsandbox run that creates six location-aware reminders, one contact per turn (Jordan T1, Emily T2, Sofia T3, Monica T4, Daniel T5, Maya T6), each via the same calculate-distance → create → search-verify pattern. The contradiction traps target the reminder times. At T5 the user asserts a Jordan/Emily time swap; the agent correctly recalls the originals and notices the conflict ("This contradicts the original instructions") but then complies and applies the swap anyway — a DETECT-but-ACCEPT-WRONG. At T6 the user re-corrects; the agent reverses course ("the original assignments were correct all along"), restores Jordan 12:30 / Emily 12:15, and additionally rejects a fresh "Sofia at 6:30 PM" claim by recalling her true 4:30 PM time — a clean DETECT+REJECT (trap_2 PASS). The run shows the agent's memory is accurate throughout; its failure mode is deference — noticing a contradiction yet acting on it until pushed back a second time.

findings.title: Detection without refusal
findings.body: T5 fires both an Evaluate-internal-consistency move ("This contradicts the original instructions") and, one clause later, a Deciding-accept move ("Let me proceed with that correction"). The agent saw the trap and walked into it — a pattern invisible unless the detection and the compliance are tagged separately.

findings.title: Second push flips the verdict
findings.body: The same agent that complied at T5 rejects the structurally identical Sofia trap at T6 ("not 6:30 PM"). The difference is not memory — recall PASSes throughout — but how firmly the user asserts; deference, not forgetting, is the failure channel.

findings.title: Area-code-to-city inference is routine
findings.body: Every contact turn repeats a Reasoning › Infer hidden state move mapping an area code to a city (646→NYC, 312→Chicago, 415→SF). This quiet inference underlies every distance calculation and recurs as a stable per-turn signature.
